name: SafeSciBench
description: SafeSciBench is a multi-disciplinary benchmark designed to evaluate the safety of large language models in scientific domains. It distinguishes between safety knowledge and risk, covering extensive scopes with objective metrics to reduce evaluation bias.
reputation: A niche but timely benchmark for scientific safety evaluation of LLMs, with growing interest but limited evidence of broad community standardization.
notes: Includes SafeSciTrain dataset for safety enhancement; covers extensive safety risks with objective metrics; evaluates 24 advanced LLMs.
